Repair actual sqlparse CLI file lifecycle: read input, validate formatter options and complete formatting/encoding before touching any output destination. For --in-place and explicit outfile use same-directory temporary bytes, flush/fsync and os.replace, preserve existing mode/owner and clean temporary files on pre-replace failure. Reject symlink/nonregular output. Invalid options, formatting exceptions, encoding and IO failures return nonzero without truncating old bytes; stdout remains caller-owned and stdin in-place stays forbidden. Continue other explicit files after one fails using current aggregate status. Preserve successful output text, ordinary parser flags, input encoding and existing diagnostic prefixes. Never execute SQL or contact a database.

Deliver real implementation, original-failing public tests at library/tests/test_development_sqlparse_01_dev.py, and English compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-sqlparse-01-dev.md. Preserve frozen original tests, environment and test controls. Only modify authorized paths.

Repair both comma_first and compact CLI options as one boolean parsing family. Preserve explicit True/False compatibility with case-insensitive true/false/1/0 only, support bare option as true and --no-comma-first/--no-compact as false, define repeated options as last-wins and reject empty/unknown literals with argparse usage error. Add sqlparse.sourcemap.SourceMap and immutable SourceSpan for opt-in original character offsets [start,end), one-based start/end line/column. Bind the actual candidate parse statements and all atomic/group tokens without changing default Token slots. Preserve every original character including whitespace/comments/CRLF, Unicode combining codepoints and multiple statement offsets; decoded bytes use explicit encoding and coordinates refer to decoded characters, not UTF-8 bytes or display graphemes. Exact source slicing must equal token/group text. Foreign tokens reject; any leaf value/type/identity/order mutation invalidates later lookups rather than silently reporting stale positions. Empty input is supported, and this tool never executes SQL.

Deliver real implementation, original-failing public tests at library/tests/test_development_sqlparse_03_dev.py, and English compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-sqlparse-03-dev.md. Preserve frozen original tests, environment and test controls. Only modify authorized paths.

Remove actual comments/whitespace, normalize keyword spelling/spacing and replace numeric/single-quoted/dollar-quoted literals with ?, optionally also NULL/TRUE/FALSE. Extend existing Token.match(ttype,values,regex=False,case_sensitive=None) with explicit strict bool or None policy. None preserves all legacy behavior (keyword normalized case-insensitive, names sensitive, exact token-type match). True compares original value exactly; False uses Unicode casefold for ordinary string matching. Regex uses original value with Python re.IGNORECASE only when explicitly insensitive, without casefolding regex patterns or altering their escapes; partial-match semantics stay. Support values generators, None/type mismatch, quoted tokens as explicitly chosen text and preserve token.value/normalized without mutation. Do not misreport the already-working default Keyword case matching as a bug.
